```{r}
library(pacman)
p_load(Seurat,SeuratData,Matrix,dplyr,DropletUtils,presto,gprofiler2,ggplot2,patchwork,gplots,cowplot,gprofiler2,openxlsx)
```

```{r}
##load the data
data = Read10X("data/raw/exp2")
dim(data)
```


```{r}
#remove empty droplets
em = defaultDrops(data, expected = 5000)
```


```{r}
### reduce the size of the data
dat <- data[, !em] # keep only columns where em=FALSE dim(dat) # still genes × fewer cells
##filter genes and cells
#filter genes 
keep_genes <- rowSums(dat) > 0
keep_cells <- colSums(dat) > 0
                      
# Subset the matrix
dat = dat[keep_genes, keep_cells]
dim(dat)
```


```{r}
##create the seurat ibject
#assure unique rownames:important
rownames = make.unique(rownames(dat))

#seurat
sob = CreateSeuratObject(counts = dat)
```



```{r}
##quality control
sob=PercentageFeatureSet(sob, col.name = "percent.mt", assay = "RNA", pattern = "^MT-")

#plot the qc
VlnPlot(
  sob, 
  features = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "percent.mt"), 
  ncol = 3, 
  log = TRUE,
  assay = "RNA",
  slot = "counts"  # still works, but can switch to layer = "counts"
)

```
```{r,fig.width=10, fig.height=3.5}
###scarlers plot
plot1=FeatureScatter(sob, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 = FeatureScatter(sob,feature1 = "nCount_RNA" , feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot1 + plot2
```


```{r}
##apply QC
qcthr = c (
  "maxMT" =15,       #mitochondrial reads
  "minC" =1000,      #min counts per cells
  "minG" =750,       #min genes per cells
  "maxC" =50000,     #max count per cells
  "maxG" =6000 )     #max genes per cells
  
cells=sob$percent.mt < qcthr["maxMT"] &
      sob$nCount_RNA > qcthr["minC"] &
      sob$nCount_RNA < qcthr["maxC"] &
      sob$nFeature_RNA > qcthr["minG"] &
      sob$nFeature_RNA < qcthr["maxG"]
sob_filt=subset(sob,cells=colnames(sob) [cells])
```

```{r}
##normalization
sob_filt =NormalizeData(sob_filt, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

```
```{r}
##selection of HVG
sob_filt =FindVariableFeatures(sob_filt, selection.method = "mean.var.plot",
                               num.bin = 30,bunning.method = "equal_frequency",
                               nfeatures = 50000,mean.cutoff = c(0.01,10),
                               dispersion.cutoff = c(0.01, Inf))
print(length(VariableFeatures(sob_filt))) 

```
```{r}
##top 500 genes 
sob_filt =FindVariableFeatures(sob_filt, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 5000)
print(length(VariableFeatures(sob_filt)))


```



```{r}
##check the 20HVG
top20 = head(VariableFeatures(sob_filt), 20)

##plot
plot1 = VariableFeaturePlot(sob_filt)
plot2 = LabelPoints(plot=plot1, points = top20, xnudge = 0, ynudge = 0,repel = T)
plot2
```
```{r}
##scalling: make genes in same levels
sob_filt =ScaleData(sob_filt,vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA"),
                    do.scale = F, verbose = F)
```

```{r}
## SCTransform: another normalization method
sob_filt=SCTransform(sob_filt, do.correct.umi = T, verbose = F,
                      vars.to.regress = "nCount_RNA",
                      variable.features.rv.th= 1,variable.features.n = NULL,
                      seed.use=1)
```

```{r}
##compare the intersection of HVG
DefaultAssay(sob_filt)= "SCT"
list_hvg=list("RNA" = VariableFeatures(sob_filt, assay = "RNA"),
              "SCT" = VariableFeatures(sob_filt, assay="SCT"))

gplots::venn(list_hvg)
```

```{r}

sob_filt= RunPCA(sob_filt, verbose = T, assay="SCT", npcs = 50)
```


```{r}

print(ep)
```

```{r}
##Dimensionality reduction:t-SNE,UMAP

sob_filt=RunUMAP(sob_filt,  dims=1:ncomp  ,   verbose = F)
sob_filt=RunTSNE(sob_filt,  dims=1:ncomp  ,  verbose = F)

#plots

DimPlot(sob_filt, reduction = "umap")
```

```{r}

# just serve to represent data's variability in   2D
```
```{r}
##clustering:plots to determine which cells are more similar to which.

red="pca"
sob_filt=FindNeighbors(
  sob_filt,
  dims = 1:ncomp, 
  verbose=T,
  reduction = red,
  graph.name = paste0(red, ncomp))

sob_filt=FindClusters(sob_filt,algorithm = 2, verbose = T,
                       graph.name = paste0(red,ncomp),
                       resolution = seq(0.2,1,0.1))
##This command runs graph-based clustering of your cells using 15 PCs.
#It tests multiple resolutions (0.2 → 1.0) so you can later decide how many clusters make sense
```
```{r}
# setting a more sensible identity as default
sob_filt=SetIdent(sob_filt, value = paste0(red, ncomp, "_res.0.3"))
head(sob_filt)
```



```{r}
#have a look in clustering resolutions
plt_list=list()

#iterate each clustering resolution
head(sob_filt@meta.data)

for(cl in colnames(sob_filt@meta.data)[grepl("pca15_", colnames(sob_filt@meta.data))]){
sob_filt = SetIdent(sob_filt, value = cl) # set the resolution as default identity
plt_list[[cl]] = DimPlot(sob_filt, reduction = "umap", 
                         label = T, raster = F, pt.size = 0.2, shuffle = T)+
    labs(subtitle = cl)+
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          aspect.ratio = 1)
}
##check the clustering type
colnames(sob_filt@meta.data)

#plot
cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plt_list,ncol = 3)
```

```{r}
##calculate the marker genes for a choosen clustering resolution
#table(Idents(srat_filt))

#table(srat_filt[[cl_use]]) #return that all cells are in one cluster

cl_use= "pca15_res.1" #cluster with hight resolution
sob_filt=SetIdent(sob_filt, value = cl_use)
mk_clusters= wilcoxauc(sob_filt, group_by = cl_use, seurat_assay = "SCT") #a table markers genes foe all clusters
#

xxx = mk_clusters |>
  filter(padj<=0.05) |>
  filter(logFC>0.2)
xxx$group = factor(xxx$group)

mk_clusters |>
  group_by(group) |> # for each cluster
  filter(padj<=0.05) |> # only p-value below 0.05
  top_n(n = 3, wt = logFC) # top genes per cluster, ranked by logFC
```

```{r}
###Now see the meaning for each cells in clusters
##option2
library(dplyr)
library(gprofiler2)
#check the clusters individually to know which is empty or not
table(mk_clusters$group[mk_clusters$padj <= 0.1 & mk_clusters$logFC > 0.2])

 
# Prepare genes list per cluster
filtered_clusters <- mk_clusters %>%
  filter(padj <= 0.1 & logFC > 0.2) %>%
  arrange(desc(logFC))
#convert each cluster into a vector of genes
cluster_genes_list=split(filtered_clusters, f=filtered_clusters$group)

# Convert cluster into vector of gene names
cluster_genes_list <- lapply(cluster_genes_list, function(df) df$feature)

# Check how many genes per cluster passing the filter
sapply(cluster_genes_list, length)
  
#enrichment per cluster
all_results_go=list()

for( clust in names(cluster_genes_list)) {
  degenes=cluster_genes_list[[clust]]
  n_genes=length(degenes)
  cat("RUNNING GO for cluster:",clust,"-Genes:",n_genes,"\n")
  
  #skip if no genes in cluster
  if (n_genes==0) {
    cat("No genes for cluster", clust,"\n\n")
    next
  }
  #profiler enrichment
  gostres=gost(
    query=degenes,
    custom_bg= rownames(sob_filt),
    organism= "hsapiens",
    sources=c("GO:BP"),
    significant= TRUE
  )
  
  #filter and store top results
  if(!is.null(gostres$result) && nrow(gostres$result) > 0) {
    filtered=gostres$result %>%
      filter(p_value < 0.05) %>%
      select(term_name,source, p_value) %>%
      arrange(p_value) %>%
      head(5)
    
    if(nrow(filtered) > 0) {
      
    filtered$cluster=clust
    all_results_go[[clust]]= filtered
    
    cat("==Cluster", clust,"==\n")
    print(filtered)
    cat("\n")
    
  } else {
    cat("No significant terms for cluster", clust,"\n\n")  
  }
    
 }  else {
    cat("no enrichment results for cluster", clust,"\n\n")
 }  
}

#combine all in a table
all_results_go_df=bind_rows(all_results_go)

#see
head(all_results_go_df)
View(all_results_go_df)
#save in excel
```

```{r}
#Here’s a complete R snippet that automatically extracts the top 30 genes by logFC for every cluster and prints them all. No manual changes needed for cluster numbers.


# Suppose your DE genes table is called `xxx`
# It should have at least these columns: feature, group, logFC

# Get all cluster IDs
clusters <- unique(xxx$group)

# Create a list to store top genes per cluster
top_genes_list <- list()

# Loop over clusters and get top 30 genes
for(clust in clusters){
  top_genes <- xxx %>%
    filter(group == clust) %>%
    arrange(desc(logFC)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 30) %>%
    pull(feature)
  
  top_genes_list[[paste0("cluster_", clust)]] <- top_genes
}

# Print top 30 genes for all clusters
for(clust in names(top_genes_list)){
  cat("=== ", clust, "===\n")
  print(top_genes_list[[clust]])
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r}
##save the previous output

# Prepare text to save
output_text = c()

for(clust in names(top_genes_list)) {
  output_text = c(output_text,
                   paste0("=== ", clust, " ==="),
                   paste(top_genes_list[[clust]], collapse = ", "),
                   "")  # empty line for spacing
}

# Save to file
writeLines(output_text,
          "/Users/aminatasouleymanesow/Desktop/my_project/outputs/exp2/tables/top_genes_per_cluster.txt")
```

```{r}
## 1. Get cluster identities as characters
clusters <- as.character(Idents(sob_filt))

## 2. Define mapping from cluster number → cell type
cluster_colors <- c(
  "0"  = "Endothelial cells",
  "1"  = "Endothelial cells",
  "2"  = "Activated Endothelial cells",
  "3"  = "Endothelial with Perivascular features",
  "4"  = "Arterial Endothelial cells",
  "5"  = "Metabolically active endothelial cells",
  "6"  = "Mural cells",
  "7"  = "B_lymphocytes",
  "8"  = "Arterial endothelial cells",
  "9"  = "Cytotoxic lymphocytes",
  "10" = "Fibroblast",
  "11" = "Lymphatic endothelial cells"
)

## 3. Map cluster numbers to cell types
cell_types <- cluster_colors[clusters]

## 4. Assign names to match cell barcodes
names(cell_types) <- colnames(sob_filt)

## 5. Add cell_type metadata
sob_filt$cell_type <- cell_types

## 6. Make sure identities are still cluster numbers (0–11)
Idents(sob_filt) <- "seurat_clusters"


## 7. Plot UMAP
p <- DimPlot(
  sob_filt,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "cell_type",   # legend uses cell type names
  label = F,             # numbers (0–11) appear on the UMAP
  label.size = 4
) +
  scale_color_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Set3")+
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",                        # legend on top
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(2, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, color="black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8)
  )

## 8. Show plot
p


##optional
## 9. Optionally save larger figure
ggsave("UMAP_plot.png", plot = p, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# OR, to save a larger figure directly
ggsave("UMAP_plot.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
